decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The equipment hereby approved shall be removed within one year of the date of this permission, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (38081/101A, 38081/102A, 38081/103A, 38081/104A, Design and Access Statement, prediction coverage analysis and declaration of conformity with ICNIRP public exposure guidelines. Received: 21st February 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Temporary retention of a mobile telecommunications apparatus, consisting of a cabin topped with 15m lattice mast topped with antennas and development ancillary thereto (known as portocell), installed within the hotel grounds site under emergency powers, for the duration of redevelopment works affecting the permanent rooftop site.
